messages:
Raj: Quick sync — postmortem from last night's latency spike (3xxs on /generate) finished. Need to lock owners and SLO adjustments before weekly review.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: 2025-11-02 02:14 UTC — increased p95 latency for /generate, error budget burn 12% in 1h. Linked: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20251102-03 :warning:

Emily: I skimmed the postmortem. Root cause = KV cache churn + a bad rollout of quantized model variant. We should update SLOs for the next 30 days while remediation lands.

Selena: Proposal: keep global API SLO at p95 < 300ms, but split route-level SLOs and set /generate p95 to 350ms for 30d with a note. Owner for fixes: @Selena (I'll take the remediation for cache TTLs).

Mike: I'll own dashboarding + alerts. Plan: add a per-route SLO dashboard and an error-budget burn alert for >5% in 10m + >10% sustained 1h. Dashboard path: Grafana /dashboards/SLOs->service/generator.

Denise: Can we also add synthetic traffic for /generate at 2 concurrent flows to catch regression? And add a pager rule only if 3xx% > 5% AND p95 > 1s for 5m.

Emily: Agreed on synthetics. Also suggest a temporary change to SLO config so automated rollouts will not select quantized-variant v2 until we validate perf.

Mike: I'll update the SLO YAML and the dashboard. Pushing a draft here for visibility:

```
service: generator
slo:
  - name: "p95-latency"
    window: 30d
    target: 0.95
    objective_ms: 350
    buckets: [100,200,350,500,1000]
  - name: "availability"
    window: 30d
    target: 0.999
alerting:
  error_budget_burn:
    - rule: "burn_10pct_1h"
      threshold_pct: 10
      window: 1h
    - rule: "burn_5pct_10m"
      threshold_pct: 5
      window: 10m
```

Raj: Nice. Action items: 1) Selena — implement cache TTL change + migration plan (due 3 business days). 2) Mike — create dashboard and alerts + add synthetic job (due 2 business days). 3) Emily — block quantized variant v2 in rollout policy and add signoff step (due EOD tomorrow). 4) Denise — add pager rule and test alerting (due 2 business days). 5) Raj — update postmortem with SLO changes and link dashboards (due 48h).

Selena: Taking item 1. I'll add a checklist in the postmortem comment thread and attach the config diff.

Mike: Taking item 2. I'll create a canary synthetic first thing, then wire alerts to the oncall rotation with a runbook link.

Denise: Taking item 4. I'll also add a metric for 'kv_cache_fill_rate' to the dashboard so we can correlate.

Emily: I'll draft the rollout block and the permission rule: `allow-quantized-v2: false` until manual approve.

Raj: Cool. Two follow-ups: (A) let's record this as a recurring pattern if cache churn shows up twice in 90 days; trigger a deeper redesign epi. (B) We should add a weekly SLO health email to product and platform leads for 4 weeks.

Mike: +1 on pattern detection. I'll add a Prometheus recording rule that counts 'cache_churn_events' in 90d window. If >2, post to #architecture and create a JIRA epic template.

Selena: :thumbsup: I'm on the migration plan and will put steps + rollback details.

Denise: Will test pager noise on staging then schedule a brief oncall training so people know the new thresholds.

Emily: Ack. I'll post the rollout block PR and @Raj please review.

Raj: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and timelines and re-open for comments. If anyone misses their deadline, ping @Raj and @Emily. :white_check_mark: 

Mike: Quick note — can we make the dashboard show tokenized cost impact per 1000 requests? helps product tradeoffs.

Emily: Good add. Mike, can you place a small cost card under the SLO dashboard.

Mike: Yep. Adding now.

Selena: One last: tagging this thread 'slo-followup' in the postmortem so weekly review picks it up.

Raj: Done. Closing the thread for now, will reopen when PRs land.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Next oncall rotation will receive the new alert rules after Mike wires them.
